关于庙会的故事(A Story about the temple fair): 一篇关于节日文化的A2短文:伊娃与格蕾丝的经历和小计划。
Last Thursday, Eva and Grace went to the temple fair. Eva hopes to visit London one day. There are always many people at the lantern street. Also, an apple a day keeps the doctor away.
Eva thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Eva is going to travel to London in December. Eva learned a lot about science. The clasp on my necklace is broken again.
Eva wrote about the day in the diary. Grace is interested in dancing. Life is full of small surprises. Our train stopped in Frankfurt for ten minutes.
Eva's favorite animal is the panda. Eva and Grace had great fun there. Eva plays tennis with Grace every Thursday.
